nodes.description: Token symbol string, set to SRK at deployment.
Token name string, set to Shrink Finance at deployment.
Token decimals, set to 18.
Private total supply, initialized to 200000000000000000000 and reduced by the burn on every transfer.
Constant 100 used as the fee/burn basis in findOnePercent.
Mapping of holder address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
Deployment constructor, mints the whole supply to msg.sender and emits a Transfer event from address(0).
Public view returning _totalSupply.
Public view returning the balance of a holder.
Public view returning the allowance an owner granted to a spender.
Private view computing the burn amount: rounds the amount up to a multiple of 100 then takes 5% of it.
Transfers tokens, burns a 5% fee via findOnePercent, updates balances and _totalSupply, emits Transfer events.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to amount and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens on behalf of from using the caller allowance, burns a 5% fee, updates balances, _totalSupply and allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for balance checks, minting and allowance bookkeeping.
State write in the constructor: balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply (initial mint, no access restriction beyond deployment).
Multi-step state update in transfer: balance debit, balance credit, burn of _totalSupply and _totalSupply.sub(tokensToBurn) without reentrancy guard.
Multi-step state update in transferFrom: balance debit, credit, _totalSupply burn and allowance decrement without reentrancy guard.

Library helper performing checked subtraction.
Library helper performing checked multiplication.
Library helper performing division.
